scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 71(1), (3), (7), (10)-(11), 94, 95(1A), 98(1), 99(2)-(3), (7), 101AA(1)-(2), 101AB(1), (4) of the revised text as at 31 July 2026. Left out on purpose: contracting out and GMPs, revaluation and SSB computation, cash equivalent calculation, transfer destinations, Part 4ZA, the Ombudsman.

not_reviewed.note: No domain expert has read this against the Act. An independent test pass was run on 2026-10-18 (tests-independent.l4, 81 assertions from expectations written before the encoding was read); four failed (short service benefit needs service ending before normal pension age; s 99(7) six months read like s 99(2)) and the encoding was corrected. The pipeline has not been run.

forks.F1: Several periods: earlier counting service placed before the latest period.
forks.F3: s 101AA three-month condition; members with SSB are outside Chapter 5.
forks.F4: Refund: employee contributions plus transfer-related contributions capped at the transfer payment.
forks.F5: s 95(1A): last day of 3 months beginning with guarantee date; earlier of that and one year before NPA for non-flexible.
forks.F6: s 99(2)-(3): 6 months beginning with guarantee/application date; later of that and 3 months after proceedings conclude.
forks.F7: s 99(7): within the 6 months beginning with the date, as s 99(2).
